EFW_VaelPlatforms.name: Vael-Tor Platforms
EFW_VaelPlatforms.text: A storm-battered orbital-transfer complex built over much older structures. Present-day workers understand it as infrastructure; Episode 3 reveals that the world beneath them has a forgotten military history physically embedded in it.

EFW_SmugglingHold.name: Smuggling Skiff Hold
EFW_SmugglingHold.text: A cramped working cargo hold where Tyrus treats Theo's shard as ordinary contraband until the room briefly reflects a history neither man lived.

EFW_DefenseAccess.name: Defense Grid Access
EFW_DefenseAccess.text: A neglected platform access chamber controlling an old defensive barrier around Vael-Tor. Keep the controls mundane; the horror is that the system's purpose belongs to an erased war and has begun acting on present civilians.

EFW_AntiquarianArchive.name: Antiquarian Archives
EFW_AntiquarianArchive.text: Adrian's temporary work space on Vael-Tor, full of ordinary catalogued fragments. Theo brings the shard here seeking a name and forces Adrian to confront the difference between an artifact and a surviving history.

EFW_PlatformSublevel.name: Platform Sub-Level
EFW_PlatformSublevel.text: An exposed access gantry where Rae confronts Mero's remembered logic while trying to open a path for a damaged refugee transport.

EFW_SkiffDock.name: Skiff Loading Dock
EFW_SkiffDock.text: A commercial departure point where Ryn controls access. Theo needs passage off-platform while the shard increasingly causes the surrounding world to remember what lies beneath it.

EFW_ObservationDeck.name: Vael-Tor Observation Deck
EFW_ObservationDeck.text: A view over the damaged refugee transport and defensive barrier. Rae stops Vyn from sacrificing the ship and commits herself to opening the barrier instead.

EFW_Promenade.name: Vael-Tor Promenade
EFW_Promenade.text: A crowded rain-slick commercial concourse where Theo's inherited combat reflex becomes visible to strangers and the shadow of a buried warship briefly crosses a present-day crowd.

EFW_ShieldEmitter.name: Exterior Shield Emitter
EFW_ShieldEmitter.text: An exposed storm deck where Rae and Jace manually release the old defense barrier. The danger is physical weather, height, failing equipment and time—not technical exposition.

EFW_LaunchBay7.name: Launch Bay Seven
EFW_LaunchBay7.text: A broad bay overlooking the Vael-Tor terrain. Theo and Adrian witness the ground open as forgotten architecture returns at impossible scale.

EFW_LaunchObservation.name: Launch Bay Observation
EFW_LaunchObservation.text: A protected viewing chamber facing the fully emerged ancient dreadnought. The episode ends on Adrian finally abandoning denial without explaining how the impossible event occurred.
